title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: Calls for the annual rule of law report to continue to include a dedicated assessment of the corruption situation in the Member States, as a key tool to monitor progress in the implementation of the strategy; calls on the Commission to formulate recommendations that are more specific, operational and readily implementable, covering both preventive and enforcement aspects of anti-corruption policies, and to strengthen the monitoring of their implementation in subsequent reporting cycles; calls for country-specific recommendations to be formulated as SMART objectives (specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound);
